name: Perindopril
mechanism: ACE inhibition reducing angiotensin II and aldosterone
dosing: Hypertension: start 2-4mg daily and titrate as tolerated
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis, history of ACEi-induced angioedema
monitoring: eGFR and potassium baseline and 1–2 weeks after initiation
clinicalPearls: Used widely in UK cardiology/HTN pathways
